title: Mrs. Ilana Alouf: "Parashat Vayera"

chapters.title: The laughter of Avraham Avinu and Sarah
chapters.about: Targum Onkelos, Zohar, shock versus mindfulness

chapters.title: Destruction of Sdom and Avraham's prayer
chapters.about: Brit Milah, Sdom, prayer for ten righteous people

chapters.title: Avraham Avinu and Avimelech
chapters.about: Gerar, Yirat Shamayim, justice and law

summary: Mrs. Alouf discusses Parashat Vayera, focusing on how Hashem teaches Avraham Avinu to balance love and kindness with judgment and justice. She explains the news of Yitzchak's birth, the destruction of Sdom, Avraham's dialogue with Avimelech, and the Akedah. She also examines commentary from Rashi and Sfat Emet on Hashem's request to Avraham Avinu at the Akedah.
subjects: Avraham Avinu and Avimelech in Gerar
Commentary of Rashi and Sfat Emet
questions: Why did Hashem introduce judgment and justice to Avraham Avinu alongside kindness?
How do the reactions of Avraham Avinu and Sarah differ when hearing the news of Yitzchak's birth?
Why was Sdom destroyed despite Avraham Avinu praying for the city?
What does Sfat Emet say about Hashem asking Avraham Avinu using the phrase Kach Na at the Akedah?
